title: Phase 63 turns named conversion files into an explicit next-evidence calendar
summary: Every Phase 61 file now has one gate record joined to its latest Phase 62 event, exact dated check or source-explicit trigger, same-entity Phase 60 binding state, artifact, stop rule, and propagation surfaces.
evidence_note: Phase 63 reorganizes existing reviewed gates. It does not complete a future check, invent a trigger date, add a receipt, transfer evidence across entities, or create a readiness or urgency score.
prior_state: The Phase 60 schedule, Phase 61 next gates, and Phase 62 event histories were inspectable but required separate reads to understand what could move each named file next.
current_state: Eight joined gate records distinguish four dated files from four trigger-based files and expose the exact binding, artifact, receipt state, stop rule, and propagation surface for each.
publication_effect: Publishes one calendar briefing, one eight-record public gate export, and this update without changing an underlying signal, event, receipt, or evidence stage.
